senses.gloss: हृ॑द् n. (optionally substituted for हृदय in the weak cases i.e. in all except the first five inflexions; thought to be connected with श्रद्, q.v.) the heart (as the seat of feelings and emotions), soul, mind (as seat of thought and intellectual operations; हृद्य् अवेदिन्, ‘having no capacity of knowledge in the heart or mind’, said of animals), breast, chest, stomach, interior (also in older language, ‘interior of the body’), RV.; &c.
